# imatinib mesylate - targets 
## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
ABL1, DDR1, DDR2, PDGFRB, KIT, BCR 
Variant Targets (CIViC): BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 V299L, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 Y253H, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 G250E, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 E255K, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F359C, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F359V, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 E255V, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F317L 
More:
  biomcp get drug "imatinib mesylate" approvals   - Drugs@FDA approval history
  biomcp get drug "imatinib mesylate" label   - approved-indication and FDA label detail beyond the base card
  biomcp get drug "imatinib mesylate" regulatory --region us   - approval and supplement history; use only if the base card lacks approval context

All:
  biomcp get drug "imatinib mesylate" all --region us 
See also:
  biomcp search article --drug "imatinib mesylate" --type review --limit 5   - supplement sparse structured data with review literature for indication context
  biomcp drug trials "imatinib mesylate"
  biomcp drug adverse-events "imatinib mesylate"   - inspect safety reports and adverse-event signal
  biomcp search pgx -d "imatinib mesylate"   - pharmacogenomics interactions
  biomcp get gene ABL1
